identifiabilityRule.degenerateClusterGate: The port restriction to the rank-r target cluster must have rank r throughout the loop.
identifiabilityRule.remainingEquivalence: A minimal realization is identifiable only up to internal unitary equivalence unless the port-to-carrier map is independently calibrated.
